scope: Ordinary selected-target Win32 cursor capture correction; no native rerun by this reviewer.
reviewed_invariants: A selected target-thread WH_GETMESSAGE hook consumes only the private registered wake/cookie path; native command handler and hook chaining execute on the selected GUI thread. No WndProc replacement, class-cursor guess or host cursor query is added.

The hook processes a wake only on PM_REMOVE; peeks do not clear the queued cookie. Current cookies are coalesced and never wrap/reuse. Selected HWND, process, thread, attachment, association and cookie are revalidated around the native handler.

SendMessageW invokes the selected window native WM_SETCURSOR handler without holding lifecycle/pending locks. Only handled, unchanged-generation/current-context completion reads target-thread GetCursor. Explicit intercepted Notify changes the generation and wins, including hidden/failed states.

Native sampling reserves a new request only after lifecycle try-lock/context/sequence validation; copied cursor publication retains the already-reviewed bounded stock/custom/hidden and post-receive semantics.

Stop invalidates cookie/context and removes the thread hook; failed Unhook retains its handle and is retried by the worker before STOPPED acknowledgement/global removal. In-flight callbacks retain Arc ownership and the DLL stays loaded. Normal non-private messages continue through CallNextHookEx.
unit_scope: private_wake_coalesces_peeks_and_rejects_old_association_cookie tests the production atomic cookie transition; not actual OS message-pump interleavings.
native_sample_never_overwrites_intercepted_or_reassociated_cursor tests the production sampling predicate with real RequestClock updates; native handler behavior still needs the ordinary C gate.
Earlier two receive/fallback regressions remain in the producer; exact scheduling/unhook-failure interleavings have source coverage, not forced native tests.
limits: Source approval and parent-owned 195-test producer are separate from native/pixel acceptance.
Only the forthcoming owned ordinary EDIT case may establish its runtime path; no arbitrary app/API, animation, same-process multi-user, mixed-DPI or high-rate queue-pressure claim.
No host GetCursorInfo/GetCursorPos/SetCursorPos, hardware, RustDesk, screen capture, native apps or Cargo calls were used in this review.
